title: SvgClipPath
responsibility: Renders the native clipPath element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgClipPath.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet callback for content inside the native clipPath element. When supplied, it is rendered; when omitted, no child content is rendered.

outputs.name: SvgClipPath
outputs.description: The rendered native SVG clipPath element. Remaining props are spread onto it, and the optional child snippet is rendered inside it only when supplied; no wrapper is added.
